caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornately designed teapot positioned centrally against a plain background. The teapot features a large, rounded body with a pronounced, curved handle on the left side and an elongated, decorative spout on the right side. The handle has detailed scrollwork at both the top and bottom, and the spout curves upwards with a flourish at its tip. The lid is domed, topped with a knob that resembles a flower or finial. Shading and varying densities of fine black lines and cross-hatching create the appearance of metallic texture and reflections on the teapot’s surface. The composition employs only shades of black, gray, and the uncolored paper background, accentuating the reflective quality and form of the teapot without the use of additional objects or colors.
title: Pewter Teapot
